_about: TAGANT / DOVE MAN — measured and placed in Blender (Desktop/webcore/dove man.blend). Godot coordinates (Y up); Blender (x,y,z) = Godot (x,z,-y). Units: metres, seconds.

dinos.about: Circumambulation: each dino walks counter-clockwise around Dove Man near the edges of the world, on its own wandering track (ring + lobes + slow drift, metres). Speeds in m/s. Footprints fade after print_life_s.

_changes: v2: Godzilla uses the original asset (res://assets/godzilla) with Blender's exact fit; cars scaled x3.5; camels are individual procedural characters (characters/camel.gd); rocks accumulate (characters/falling_rocks.gd).

timeline.about: The hour. Values are interpolated between keys (minutes). car_interval [0,0] = no cars; gz_wait [0,0] = Godzilla no longer comes.

birds.about: Flocks of at most 7 (TAGANT score). Birds over the hour: start + (end-start) * (minute/60)^power -> about 10 at 10 min, 19 at 20, 30 at 30, 52 at 45, 77 at 60.

pilgrims._note: Mannequins walk the tawaf: counter-clockwise around Dove Man, slow, shuffling like the undead. Per group: ring radius (m), ring spread (+/- m per person), breath (slow drift of the ring), walk speed per metre of height (m/s).

score._note: Records the hour for the score (characters/score_recorder.gd). Saved to dove_man/scores/ when the hour ends or the scene is stopped.
